description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case class 'EmploymentContractDaoTest' which tests the methods of 'EmploymentContractDao' related to retrieving employment contract data for employees within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup routines, fixtures loading, and assertions verifying correct contract retrieval by employee number.

classes.name: EmploymentContractDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test suite for testing the EmploymentContract data access object, verifying retrieval and correctness of employment contract details for employees based on employee number.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by instantiating EmploymentContractDao and loading fixture data into the test database.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentContractByEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests the 'getEmploymentContractByEmpNumber' method of EmploymentContractDao for valid and invalid employee numbers, checking for correct contract data and null cases.
